chunks: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa narrated to us. He said: al-`Abbas b. Ma`ruf narrated to us from Muhammad b. Sahl al-Bahrani, who traced it to Abu `Abdillah al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

Those who have wept [excessively] are five – Adam, Ya`qub, Yusuf, Fatima bt. Muhammad (s) and `Ali b. al-Husayn (as). As to Adam, he wept over Paradise until his cheeks became like valleys. As to Ya`qub, he wept over Yusuf until his vision left and until he was told: "By Allah! You shall not cease to remember Yusuf until you become sick to the hilt or you are of those who perish" (12:85). As to Yusuf, he wept over Ya`qub until the inhabitants of the prison were hurt by it and they said: Either you weep by day and be silent at night or that you weep by night and be silent in the daytime. So, he agreed to one of those two with them.

And as to Fatima bt. Muhammad (s), she wept over the Messenger of Allah (s) until the people of Medina were troubled due to it. And they said to her: "You give us trouble through the excess of your crying." So, she went out towards the graves of the martyrs and wept until her need was accomplished; then she would depart. And as to `Ali b. al-Husayn, he wept over al-Husayn (as) for twenty years or forty years. And food would not be placed in front of him, but he would weep until a retainer of his said to him: "May I be ransomed for you, O son of the Messenger of Allah! I fear for you lest you be of those who perish." He said: "I only complain of my sorrow and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah what you know not. Surely, I do not remember the perdition of the children of Fatima but that I am choked with tears because of that."

key_terms.البكاءون: Those who wept excessively - a title given to five figures known for their profound grief
key_terms.بثي وحزني: My sorrow and my grief - echoing the Quranic words of Prophet Ya'qub (12:86)
key_terms.حرضا: Sick to the hilt or wasted away - a Quranic term (12:85) describing extreme illness from grief
key_terms.مصرع بني فاطمة: The perdition/massacre of the children of Fatima - referring to the tragedy of Karbala
key_terms.مقابر الشهداء: The graves of the martyrs - the cemetery in Medina where Fatima would go to weep

ai.seo_question: Who are the five great weepers in Shia Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (as) identifies five individuals who wept excessively: Adam wept for Paradise until his cheeks became like valleys; Ya'qub wept for Yusuf until he lost his sight and was admonished with the Quranic verse (12:85); Yusuf wept for Ya'qub in prison so much that inmates made him agree to cry only during the day or night; Fatima (s) wept so profusely after the Prophet's death that Medina's residents complained, causing her to go to the martyrs' cemetery instead; and Imam al-Sajjad (as) wept for Imam al-Husayn (as) for twenty or forty years, weeping at every meal, echoing Ya'qub's words from the Quran about complaining only to Allah.
